entries.voice.intro: Hello, I am Rinda. I will ask you the check-up questions out loud, one at a time. Answer in your own words. You can say skip to pass a question, repeat to hear it again, or back to change your last answer.
entries.voice.skipped: Okay, we will leave that one.
entries.voice.again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Please say your answer again, or say skip.
entries.voice.range: That number looks outside the usual range. Please say it again, or say skip.
entries.voice.number.minutes: Please say the number of minutes in a week.
entries.voice.number.servings: Please say the number of servings.
entries.voice.source: Were your body measurements taken today, or are they from memory or a recent reading?
entries.voice.source.opt.1: From memory or a recent reading
entries.voice.body.height: What is your height in centimetres?
entries.voice.body.weight: What is your weight in kilograms?
entries.voice.body.waist: What is your waist size in centimetres, measured around the belly button?
entries.voice.bp.systolic: What is the top number of your blood pressure reading?
entries.voice.bp.diastolic: What is the bottom number of your blood pressure reading?
entries.voice.wellness.ask: Would you like to answer these questions? Please say yes or no.
entries.voice.wellness.tap: For this question, please tap your answer on the screen.
entries.voice.done: That is every question. Thank you. Say send, or tap Send my check-up, to see your results.
